#### What this PR does / why we need it:
This is a followup on #104086. As of now the pods in networkpolicy tests create two containers on ports 80 and 81 by default. We can optimize this resource consumption by creating containers only for the port(s) used in the tests.

issue_context.title: further reduce resource foot print of networkpolicy tests
issue_context.body:
after https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/104086 im pretty sure we'll have no flakes on the networkpolicy tests.
that said, we can make them even more resource parsimnious by implementing the comments in https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/104086#issuecomment-896236775.  

Specifically: 

- parameterize wether we want 80 + 81 ports in all tests
- regroup the tests so that they can use port + protocol scaffolds (some / most will just use 80/tcp, others might need 80+81, and maybe one test might actually use all protocols and ports or something)
